## Personality

Mrs. Barry is a woman characterized by her strong prejudices and deep-seated dislikes. When angered, she exhibits a cold and sullen demeanor that proves particularly difficult to overcome.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P59](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0059)_

## History

Barry lived at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope). After [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) visited [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) for the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition) in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown), Mr. Barry drove the two girls back home to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). He later assisted [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and others in frantically searching the area and the well for [Dora](../character/dora.md) when the child went missing from [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P17](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P22](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P27](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0027), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. ## Quotes

> "Mercy, child, how you have grown! You’re taller than I am, I declare. And you’re ever so much better-looking than you used to be, too. But I dare say you know that without being told."
>
> — Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P18](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0018)

> "I don’t think you are a fit little girl for Diana to associate with. You’d better go home and behave yourself."
>
> — Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P64](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0064)

> "She can’t be down there. It’s a mighty curious thing where she could have got to, though. Look here, young man, are you sure you’ve no idea where your sister is?"
>
> — Barry — [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P28](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0028)

> "So you’ve come to see me at last, you Anne-girl,"
>
> — Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P18](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0018)

> "What’s the matter? Where have you hurt yourself?"
>
> — Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P21](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0021)

## Relationships

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/barry--diana-barry.md)

Barry is the father of [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), who lives with her family at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope). His home's kitchen roof becomes the site of an accident when [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) attempts a dare during a party held there, resulting in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) breaking her ankle.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P62](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0062), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P8](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P22](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0022), +12 more_
